info.name: Third Party API
info.description:
Third Party API

The Third Party API provides a comprehensive suite of endpoints for partners to manage virtual accounts, process utility payments, and initiate payouts. It is designed for seamless integration into third-party platforms that require embedded financial services.

Overview

This collection is organized into the following functional areas:

Authentication

All API requests (except token generation) require a valid Bearer token. Use the generate token endpoint to obtain an access token using your partner credentials (client_id and client_secret) using basic auth. The token is automatically saved to the token environment variable via the built-in test script.

Virtual Accounts

Create and manage virtual accounts for your customers. Supported operations include:

  • Creating static or dynamic virtual accounts

  • Retrieving all virtual accounts or filtering by reference

  • Checking account balances

  • Linking virtual accounts to USSD codes

  • Viewing transaction and transfer histories

Payouts

Initiate outbound bank transfers from virtual accounts to external bank accounts. Includes:

  • Name enquiry (account number resolution) before sending funds

  • Multi-source payout support (split across multiple virtual accounts)

  • Payout history retrieval

  • Bank listing for valid bank_id values

Utilities

Enable customers to purchase utility services directly from their virtual accounts. Supported services include airtime, data, electricity, and TV subscriptions. The utility flow is:

  1. Fetch available services

  2. Get service providers for the chosen service

  3. Retrieve service variations (plans/packages)

  4. Validate the beneficiary details (meter number, decoder, phone)

  5. Initiate the purchase via buy utility

  6. Review past purchases via utility histories

Base URL — https://app.moneta.ng/api/v1

Authentication

Endpoint Auth Type
generate token Basic Auth (live_client_id / live_client_secret)
All other endpoints Bearer Token (token)

Environment Variables

Ensure the following variables are set in your active environment before making requests:

Variable Description
url Base URL for the API
live_client_id Partner client ID for authentication
live_client_secret Partner client secret for authentication
token Access token (auto-populated by the generate token request)
virtual_account_reference Reference of the virtual account to operate on
phone_number Beneficiary phone number for utility purchases

Note: All example request bodies in this collection use dummy/placeholder data. Replace values such as account numbers, BVN, NIN, and virtual account references with real data in your environment variables before sending requests.

request.description:
Authenticates the partner using Basic Auth credentials (client ID and client secret) and returns a JWT access token. The test script automatically saves the returned access token to the token environment variable for use in subsequent requests.

Authentication: Basic Auth

  • Username: live_client_id

  • Password: live_client_secret

Test Script Behavior:
On a successful response, the access token is extracted from data.access_token and stored in the token environment variable automatically.

response.name: success

request.description:
Onboard Merchant

Registers a new merchant.

Method: POST
Endpoint: /partner/auth/onboard

Request Body

Send a JSON payload with the merchant's details. Example:

{
    "email": "example@gmail.com",
    "name": "John Doe",
    "phone": "0811111111",
    "bvn": "21000000003",
    "account_number": "1234567890",
    "account_name": "JONE DOE",
    "bank_id": 13,
    "pos_serial_no": "111111",
    "mac_address": "unknown"
}

Response

Returns the newly created merchant's details including the settlement account details

response.name: onboard merchant

request.description:
Initiates a payout (bank transfer) from one or more virtual accounts to an external bank account. Supports splitting the payout across multiple source virtual accounts.

Authentication: Bearer Token (via Authorization: Bearer {{token}} header)

Request Body:

{
  "beneficiary_bank_id": 13,
  "source_virtual_accounts": [
    {
      "virtual_account_reference": "VA_YYYYYYYYYYYYYY",
      "amount": 200
    }
  ],
  "beneficiary_account_number": "1111111111",
  "amount": 400,
  "narration": "Test Payment"
}
Field Type Required Description
beneficiary_bank_id integer Yes The bank ID of the recipient's bank. Obtain from the get banks endpoint
source_virtual_accounts array Yes List of virtual accounts to debit, each with a virtual_account_reference and amount
beneficiary_account_number string Yes The recipient's 10-digit bank account number
amount number Yes Total payout amount
narration string Yes Description or reference for the transaction

request.description:
Returns a list of all available utility services supported by the platform (e.g. airtime, data, electricity, TV subscription, etc.).

Authentication: Bearer Token

Use the service identifiers returned from this endpoint as the service field in subsequent utility requests such as service variation, beneficiary details, and buy utility.

response.name: services

request.description:
Retrieves the available variations (plans/packages) for a specific utility service and provider combination. For example, fetching all available MTN data bundles or DSTV subscription packages.

Authentication: Bearer Token

Request Body:

{
  "service": "data",
  "provider": "mtn"
}
Field Type Required Description
service string Yes The utility service type (e.g. data, tv-subscription)
provider string Yes The service provider (e.g. mtn, dstv)

The response contains a list of variation codes and their corresponding amounts, which can be used in the buy utility request.

response.name: TV
Data

request.description:
Validates and retrieves details of a utility beneficiary before initiating a purchase. This is typically used to verify a decoder number, meter number, or phone number before completing a utility transaction.

Authentication: Bearer Token

Request Body:

{
  "service": "tv-subscription",
  "provider": "dstv",
  "beneficiary_id": "0000000001"
}
Field Type Required Description
service string Yes The utility service type (e.g. tv-subscription, electricity, data)
provider string Yes The service provider (e.g. dstv, gotv, ekedc)
beneficiary_id string Yes The beneficiary identifier such as decoder number or meter number

response.name: beneficiary details

request.description:
Initiates a utility purchase (airtime, data, electricity, TV subscription, etc.) on behalf of a virtual account holder. The amount is debited from the specified virtual account.

Authentication: Bearer Token

Request Body:

{
  "service": "airtime",
  "virtual_account_reference": "VA_XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX",
  "amount": 100,
  "provider": "MTN",
  "variation_code": "",
  "beneficiary": "08000000000"
}
Field Type Required Description
service string Yes The utility service type (e.g. airtime, data, electricity, tv-subscription)
virtual_account_reference string Yes The reference of the virtual account to debit
amount number Yes The amount to purchase
provider string Yes The service provider (e.g. MTN, Airtel, DSTV)
variation_code string Conditional Required for data and TV subscriptions. Obtained from the service variation endpoint
beneficiary string Yes The recipient's phone number, meter number, or decoder number

request.description:
Retrieves a list of available service providers for a given utility category (e.g. data, airtime, electricity). The URL path segment indicates the service category.

Authentication: Bearer Token

Examples of provider categories:

  • data — Returns providers like MTN, Airtel, Glo, 9mobile
  • electricity — Returns electricity distribution companies (DISCOs)

Use the provider identifiers returned here as the provider field in service variation, beneficiary details, and buy utility requests.

toDate string (YYYY-MM-DD) Yes End date for filtering records. Example: 2025-12-31

item.name: link virtual account with a ussd code

request.description:
Links an existing virtual account to a USSD code, enabling the account holder to perform transactions via USSD. The virtual account reference is passed as a URL path parameter.

Authentication: Bearer Token (via Authorization: Bearer {{token}} header)

Path Parameter:

Parameter Type Required Description
virtual_account_reference string Yes The unique reference of the virtual account to link. Example: VA_XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX

response.name: Success Resp

request.description:
Creates a new virtual account for a customer under the authenticated partner. Supports both static and dynamic account types.

Authentication: Bearer Token (via Authorization: Bearer {{token}} header)

Request Body:

{
  "account_name": "John Doe",
  "account_type": "static",
  "surname": "Doe",
  "first_name": "John",
  "bvn": "00000000000",
  "nin": "0000000000"
}
Field Type Required Description
account_name string Yes Full name for the virtual account
account_type string Yes Type of virtual account: static (permanent) or dynamic (one-time use)
surname string Yes Customer's last name
first_name string Yes Customer's first name
bvn string Yes Customer's 11-digit Bank Verification Number (use 00000000000 for testing)
nin string Yes Customer's 10-digit National Identification Number (use 0000000000 for testing)

response.name: create-account(static)

request.description:

  "amount": 1000
}
Field Type Required Description
source_virtual_account string Yes The account number or reference of the virtual account to debit
destination_virtual_account string Yes The account number or reference of the virtual account to credit
amount number Yes The amount to transfer
